name: Blue-Green Deployment Strategy
summary: Implement a blue-green deployment strategy to minimize downtime and risks during application updates by maintaining two identical environments for production and testing.
description: The Blue-Green Deployment Strategy is a powerful approach designed to enhance the deployment process of applications while minimizing downtime and reducing risks associated with updates. This project will involve setting up two identical environments: one active (Blue) and one idle (Green). The active environment will serve live traffic, while the idle environment will be used for testing new application versions. Once the new version is validated in the Green environment, traffic will be switched from Blue to Green, ensuring a seamless transition. This strategy not only allows for quick rollbacks in case of issues but also facilitates continuous integration and delivery practices. The project will include comprehensive planning, environment setup, testing protocols, and documentation to ensure a smooth implementation and knowledge transfer to your team.
deliverables: Detailed project plan outlining the deployment strategy (document)
Setup of Blue and Green environments in AWS (work)
Testing protocols and procedures for application updates (document)
